Description: Customized Proposal HVAC Install Customized Proposal HVAC Install: AIR CONDITIONING: • Provide and install new Compact Carrier Performance Series Side discharge 30,000 BTU/Hr. SEER 14-15 R410A Condenser unit on house exterior in a convenient customer agreed location. • Equipment selected to be installed on side of the home where Main Electrical meter is currently located. This location must meet all city and manufacturer clearances. • New Equipment mounting pad will be installed and leveled to provide an adequate base for new Condenser. • Some exiting plant will have to be relocated or removed to ensure enough space for new equipment. • Provide and install new matching evaporator coil (Cooling coil) to your existing Carrier Furnace. • Air intake return grilles and vent will be left as existing. • We will relocate furnace including digging to allow for proper clearances necessary for service of Tankless Water heater and Heating/Cooling equipment. • All needed modifications to furnace and duct connections to install new Evaporator (cooling coil) are included. • All new connection will be properly sealed and supported to minimize any air loss or leakage. • System air filters will be replaced with New filter cabinet including a new high efficiency pleated filter media MERV13 • We will clean and seal seams in air return intake (close to entry door) this will improve air filtration, we will also clean existing furnace internal components to ensure proper operation. • Return duct will be increased to allow for neccesary extra airflow required for cooling mode. • Provide and install new refrigeration lines to connect the indoor and outdoor units to complete new Air conditioning system. • New refrigeration lines will run through wall then into Crawlspace using code approved wall termination. • All new wall penetrations will be properly sealed. • Perform All required EPA protocols to commission a new refrigeration system, including Nitrogen pressure testing, vacuum to 50 microns, properly charge refrigerant and test all connections to ensure a refrigerant leak free system. • Provide and install new control wiring from furnace to outdoor unit. • We will Provide and install new 240VAC/30A electrical circuit to provide power for outdoor unit, circuit will have a local fused protected service disconnect box, in addition to the properly rated circuit breaker. • A new Service outdoor outlet 120V/15A will be installed as well. As per code. • Provide and install all necessary condensation discharge piping to the exterior of the home. To be combined with new furnace condensate discharge line. • A sensor will be installed in the auxiliary drain; sensor is capable of shutting down equipment in the event of any abnormal accumulation of condensation. • Perform all necessary blower motor speed adjustments to match Air conditioning airflow/cooling capacity. • After commissioning new equipment we will test system in all modes of operation to ensure system is performing as expected.
